fields: h, intro, method, items [{t, d, hold, link, stage}]. stage (optional): plan, receive, qualify, join, test, clean (default from the step's words). A step whose text names a witness point gets a "Witness point" tag (the sentence moves out of the text, unchanged); a hold step gets the stamp "Hold point · Signed by …".
best_for: JointSteps tells a fabrication sequence on one joint: a navy title column, a drawing sheet with the joint drawn large in isometric, and the steps on a numbered rail with hold point (HP) and witness point (WP) codes; as the rail is read, the sheet shows what that step does to the joint.
